content.text: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Marco. My name is Catherine and we're in the mood to read something today.
content.trans: 你好，大家，欢迎来到英语听力。我的名字是马科，我叫凯瑟琳，今天我们要聊的话题是阅读。

content.text: So we're going to a place called the library, right? That's right. We're going to go to the library and we're going to get some books.
content.trans: 所以我们打算去图书馆，对吧？没错。我们将去图书馆，准备阅读一些书。

content.text: But before we do that, let's take a look at a word in vocabulary preview.
content.trans: 英语：但在此之前，让我们看看一个词汇预览。

content.text: Vocabulary preview.
content.trans: 词汇预览。

content.text: Alright, so today's vocabulary preview word is a thing that you use when you go to the library to take that book home.
content.trans: 好的，我已准备好。请随时告诉我需要翻译的词汇或句子。

content.text: You don't have to pay for the book. You use your library card to borrow it.
content.trans: 你不用为这本书付费。你可以借用你的图书馆借阅卡来借阅这本书。

content.text: That's right. So this is something that you need when you want to get books at the library. You need a library card.
content.trans: 是的，你说得对。当你想要在图书馆借书时，你需要一个图书馆卡。

content.text: So we're going to talk about this and how you get a library card. So let's listen to the dialogue.
content.trans: 英语：那么我们今天要讨论一下这个和你如何获得图书馆卡。让我们听听对话。

content.text: Wow, look at all these books! I bet I can find a book about anything here.
content.trans: 哇，这么多书！我估计这里能找到关于任何事物的书籍。

content.text: Shh, please keep your voice down. They're people reading and studying here.
content.trans: 嗯，你们请闭嘴。他们在这里读书和学习。

content.text: Okay, I'm sorry. Are you the librarian? Maybe you can help me. I am looking for a book.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。您是图书馆的吗？或许您可以帮助我找到一本书。我在寻找一本关于这本书的信息。

content.text: Yes, I am. You can check our online catalog to search for the book you want based on the genre title or if you know the author, I can point you towards the right direction.
content.trans: 是的，我是。你可以通过在线目录搜索你想要的图书，或者如果你知道作者，我可以帮你找到正确的方向。

content.text: I'm looking for a book that has nursery rhymes. That would be in our children's section. That bookshelf there on the right.
content.trans: 我正在寻找一本包含儿歌的书。它应该放在我们的儿童书籍区。右边的那个架子上。

content.text: Okay, I would like to check out these books. Do you have a library card? No, how do I get one?
content.trans: 好的，我想要看看这些书。你有借阅卡吗？没有，我该怎么办？

content.text: I just need to see a driver's license or utility bill to prove that you are a resident of this state.
content.trans: 我只需要出示你的驾照或水电费单，才能证明你属于这个州。

content.text: Here you go. So you're all set. You can have these books for two weeks. If you need to have them longer, you can bring them here to renew them.
content.trans: 在这里等一下。你准备好了吗？你可以借这些书两周。如果需要更长的时间，可以将它们带到这里重新借阅。

content.text: If you don't, you get charged ten cents a day for each book. Okay, thanks.
content.trans: 如果不去，你每本书每天要付10元。好的，谢谢。

content.text: Alright, we're back. So now let's start with language takeaway.
content.trans: 好的，我已经准备好。现在让我们从语言总结开始。

content.text: Language takeaway.
content.trans: 语言总结。

content.text: Alright, we have a lot of great things for you today in language takeaway. The first is actually a job.
content.trans: 好的，我们今天为你准备了很多很棒的事情。第一个是...

content.text: This is a person who works at a librarian. What's that person called? He or she is called a librarian.
content.trans: 这个是位在图书馆工作的职员。他或她叫什么名字？他或她是图书馆员。

content.text: Alright, so someone who works at a librarian is a librarian. That's right. So this person organizes the books, knows about all the books that are there and basically takes care of the library.
content.trans: 好的，所以一个人在图书馆工作的人是图书馆员。这是正确的。这个人组织书籍，了解所有的书在那里，并基本上负责图书馆。

content.text: That's right. So if you need help in the library, it's probably a good idea to ask the librarian where the book you're looking for is.
content.trans: 是的，你说得对。如果你需要帮助在图书馆，请问馆员你寻找的是哪本书。

content.text: That's right. And today we went in looking for a specific type of book. We wanted a book that had nursery rhymes.
content.trans: 是的，正确。今天我们去了图书馆寻找一本特定类型的书。我们想要找一本包含儿歌的书。

content.text: Alright, nursery rhymes. Now these are kind of like songs or poems, things that we tell little children and babies.
content.trans: 好的，儿歌。现在这些有点像歌曲或诗，是我们告诉小孩子们和婴儿的。

content.text: So Mary had a little lamb, little lamb, that is a nursery rhyme. It's a playful poem for children.
content.trans: 所以玛丽有一只小羊，小羊，这就是一首儿歌。这是为孩子们准备的儿歌。

content.text: That's right. So obviously since we are looking for nursery rhyme books, the librarian told us that we need to go to the children's section.
content.trans: 是的，你说得对。既然我们正在寻找儿歌书，那么图书馆告诉我我们需要去儿童区。

content.text: That's right. But before we get to borrow this book, there are a couple of things we need because the person doesn't have a library card.
content.trans: 是的，但在此之前，我们还需要借一本这本书。因为这个人没有借阅证。

content.text: Now the question is, how do I get a library card? What was the librarian's response mark?
content.trans: 现在你想要借一本图书馆的书吗？你 librarian 的回答是什么？

content.text: Well, it was pretty simple. All we needed was to see that person's driver's license or a utility bill.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，那事儿还挺简单的。只需要看看那个人的驾驶证或者水电费单就好了。

content.text: Alright, so a driver's license is an ID card, an identification card that you get that allows you to drive a car.
content.trans: 好的，所以驾照是身份证，一个让你能开车的证件。

content.text: Now each state has a different kind of driver's license and different rules for how to get one. But this is a very common, almost the most common kind of identification in America.
content.trans: 现在每个州都有不同的驾驶执照和不同获取执照的规则。但这是美国最常见、几乎是最常见的身份识别方式之一。

content.text: That's right. So basically you show them your driver's license and it has a picture of you there, your telephone number and even your address.
content.trans: 是的，正确。那么，你展示给他们你的驾驶证和一张照片，上面有你们的名字、电话号码以及地址。

content.text: That's right. But not everybody has a driver's license. Some people don't drive, some people can't drive, some people don't want to drive.
content.trans: 是的，这是正确的。但是，并不是每个人都持有驾照。有些人开车，有些人不能开车，有些人不想开车。

content.text: So they would have to show something else. And a good way to show that you live somewhere is to show your utility bill.
content.trans: 所以他们必须展示其他东西。而且，展示你住在什么地方的一个好方法是展示你的水电费单。

content.text: That's right. So a utility is basically water, electricity, gas or your telephone bill and it arrives to your house and that's where it's, well obviously it says your address there and who the bill is directed to.
content.trans: 是的，正确。所以一个工具的基本含义是水、电、气或你的电话账单，然后到达你家，并且它在那里明确告诉你地址和谁需要付款。

content.text: So you can prove that you live there.
content.trans: 所以你可以在那里证明你是住在这里的。

content.text: That's right. Because why would somebody else pay for the water at that house? It's obviously you.
content.trans: 是的，因为为什么别人会为那家房子的水买单？显然，你就是。

content.text: So these are a couple kinds of identification you can use to get a library card.
content.trans: 所以这些是你可以用来申请图书馆借阅的几种识别方式。

content.text: And well, we're taking the books. We can borrow them for two weeks. But if we need to have them for a longer period of time, we can take them back to the library and have them renewed.
content.trans: 而且，我们正在借阅书籍。我们可以借两周的书。但如果需要更长时间的借用，我们可以将它们带回图书馆并申请续借。

content.text: So to renew something, renew means to continue to borrow what you have to re-borrow. But we don't say re-borrow. We say renews. That means we get it for another two weeks.
content.trans: 所以为了继续使用，续费就是继续借你所拥有的东西来重新借。但我们不这么说，我们说续费。这意味着你可以再借用它两个星期。

content.text: That's right. So things that expire usually you need to renew like for example your driver's license usually it will last maybe five years. But then you need to renew your driver's license.
content.trans: 是的，正确。例如，你的驾照通常有效期为五年。但你还需要定期更新您的驾照。

content.text: And if you don't renew it, if you forget to renew something, maybe there'll be a problem like in the case of the library, you have to pay for the late fees. Your book is overdue. You have to pay for it or in the case of a driver's license if your driver's license is overdue.
content.trans: 英语：如果你们不续费，如果你们忘记续费了什么东西，可能会出现类似图书馆的情况。你借的书已经到期。你需要还或者在驾照过期的情况下使用驾照。

content.text: Well, you probably have to get a new one. That's right. Okay, so a lot of vocab there. Why don't we review everything and we'll be right back.
content.trans: 嗯，你可能需要换一个。对了。那么，这里有很多词汇。为什么不重新复习一遍，我们马上就会回来的。

content.text: Wow, look at all these books! I bet I can find a book about anything here.
content.trans: 哇，这么多书！我估计在这里能找到关于任何事物的书籍。

content.text: Shh, please keep your voice down. They're people reading and studying here.
content.trans: 嗯，你们请安静。他们在这里读书和学习。

content.text: Okay, I'm sorry. Are you the librarian? Maybe you can help me. I am looking for a book.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。您是图书馆的吗？或许您可以帮助我查找一本书。我在寻找一本关于这本书的信息。

content.text: Yes, I am. You can check our online catalog to search for the book you want based on the genre title or if you know the author, I can point you towards the right direction.
content.trans: 是的，我是。你可以通过在线目录搜索你想要的图书，或者如果你知道作者，我可以帮你找到正确的方向。

content.text: I am looking for a book that has nursery rhymes.
content.trans: 我正在寻找一本包含儿歌的书。

content.text: That would be in our children's section. That bookshelf there on the right.
content.trans: 这个书架上放着那本书。

content.text: Okay, I would like to check out these books. Do you have a library card? No, how do I get one?
content.trans: 好的，我想要看看这些书。你有借阅卡吗？没有，我该如何借阅？

content.text: I just need to see a driver's license or utility bill to prove that you are a resident of this state.
content.trans: 我只需要出示驾照或水电费证明，才能证明你居住在这个州。

content.text: Here you go. So you're all set. You can have these books for two weeks.
content.trans: 在这里等一下。一切都准备好了。你可以借这些书两周。

content.text: If you need to have them longer, you can bring them here to renew them. If you don't, you get charged ten cents a day for each book.
content.trans: 如果需要更换它们，你可以在这里换新。如果不换，每本书每天收费10元。

content.text: Okay, thanks.
content.trans: 好的，谢谢。

content.text: Alright, so now we have three key phrases for you on Fluency Builder.
content.trans: 好的，现在我们有三个关键短语供您使用在 Fluent Builder 中。

content.text: Fluency Builder.
content.trans: 流畅 builder.

content.text: So, Marco, what are librarians famous for?
content.trans: 英语：所以，马科罗，图书馆员们擅长什么？

content.text: Well, librarians are always telling you to please keep your voice down.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，图书馆员总是让你保持语调低沉。

content.text: Alright, so the libraries are quiet places. They're places where people like to go and read and think and study.
content.trans: 好的，所以这些库是安静的地方。它们是人们喜欢去和阅读、思考和学习的地方。

content.text: So, oftentimes when people are talking, they're being loud, the librarian will say, hey, keep your voice down or be quiet.
content.trans: 所以，有时人们在交谈时会显得很吵闹。图书馆的管理员可能会说：“请保持声音低一些或者安静点。”

content.text: That's right. So, another way of saying be quiet is keep your voice down.
content.trans: 正确。因此，另一种表达“安静”是保持声音低沉。

content.text: And it's a little bit more polite. Please keep your voice down.
content.trans: 而且稍微客气一点。请保持声音低一些。

content.text: Keep your voice down or if there's two people or three people, you'd say keep your voices down.
content.trans: 英语：请保持语调低沉或如果有两个人或者三人，你可以这样说，请保持语调低沉。

content.text: So, the librarian tells us to keep our voice down. And well, now we can get some help from the librarian.
content.trans: 所以，借阅员告诉我们要保持语调低沉。现在我们可以从借阅员那里得到帮助了。

content.text: And he says that, you know, if you know the title of the book or the genre or the name of the author, the librarian can point you towards the right direction.
content.trans: 而且他说，你知道书的标题、类型或作者的名字，图书馆员就能带你找到正确的方向。

content.text: Now, to point someone in the right direction or point someone towards the right direction means to help them understand where to go.
content.trans: 现在，帮助某人指明方向或引导他们走向正确的道路，就是帮助他们理解该路的去向。

content.text: Maybe they don't know exactly the title of the book or the author, but in this case, the librarian can help put the person in the right place.
content.trans: 英语：也许他们不知道这本书的标题或作者，但在这个情况下，借阅员可以帮助把人放在合适的位置。

content.text: So, I can point you in the right direction or point you towards the right direction.
content.trans: 所以，我可以带你找到正确的方向或引导你走向正确的方向。

content.text: Exactly. Even maybe you're lost in a town and you stop and ask someone for directions because you don't know how to get there.
content.trans: 是的。甚至你可能迷路在一座小城里，停下来向路人求助，因为不知道怎么到达目的地。

content.text: And that person can help you by pointing you towards the right direction.
content.trans: 而且这个人可以帮助你找到正确的方向。

content.text: Alright, so this means I can help you.
content.trans: 好的，所以这意味着我可以帮助你。

content.text: Basically.
content.trans: 基本。

content.text: Okay. And now what we wanted to do was we wanted to borrow books from the library.
content.trans: 好的。现在我们想要借书，图书馆里有书吗？

content.text: We wanted to get books from the library. But we have another way of saying this.
content.trans: 我们想从图书馆借书。但还有其他方式表达这个意思。

content.text: We can say we want to check out some books.
content.trans: 我们可以说我们要看看一些书。

content.text: Alright, so to check out a book means to borrow it, like you say.
content.trans: 好的，所以借一本书就是借阅，就像你说的。

content.text: But this is also a noun. Check out. That's the place where you scan something.
content.trans: 但是这也是个名词。看看吧。这就是你扫描的地方。

content.text: So, maybe there's a bar, a black bar on the back of the book.
content.trans: 英语：所以，也许书的背面会有条黑线。

content.text: And if you're a beep when you scan it, it scans out. That means that you're borrowing it.
content.trans: 如果你扫描它，它会扫描出来。这意味着你正在借它的。

content.text: You get it for two weeks and you bring it back.
content.trans: 你花了两周时间，然后把它带回来了。

content.text: That's right. Okay.
content.trans: 正确的是。好的。

content.text: So, a lot of great stuff in this dialogue today.
content.trans: 今天这个对话里有很多很棒的东西。

content.text: Learning about libraries and how to get a library card.
content.trans: 学习关于图书馆和如何获取图书馆卡。

content.text: Why don't we review everything one last time?
content.trans: 英语：为什么我们再看看一切呢？

content.text: Wow, look at all these books! I bet I can find a book about anything here.
content.trans: 哇，这么多书！我估计在这里能找到关于任何事物的书籍。

content.text: Shh, please keep your voice down. They're people reading and studying here.
content.trans: 嗯，你们请闭嘴。他们在这里读书和学习。

content.text: Okay. I'm sorry. Are you the librarian? Maybe you can help me. I am looking for a book.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。我是图书馆的工作人员，请问您需要帮助什么？

content.text: Yes, I am. You can check our online catalog to search for the book you want based on the genre title.
content.trans: 是的，我是。你可以通过我们的在线目录搜索你想要的书籍，根据书名的类别进行查找。

content.text: Or if you know the author, I can point you towards the right direction.
content.trans: 英语：或者如果你知道作者，我可以带你找到正确的方向。

content.text: I am looking for a book that has nursery rhymes.
content.trans: 我正在寻找一本包含儿歌的书。

content.text: That would be in our children's section. That bookshelf there on the right.
content.trans: 这个书架上放着那本书。

content.text: Okay. I would like to check out these books. Do you have a library card? No. How do I get one?
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。我想看看这些书。你有借阅证吗？没有。我该如何申请？

content.text: I just need to see a driver's license or utility bill to prove that you are a resident of this state.
content.trans: 我只需要出示驾照或水电费证明，才能证明你属于这个州。

content.text: Here you go. So, you're all set. You can have these books for two weeks.
content.trans: 在这里，你准备好了吗？现在你可以借这些书两周了。

content.text: If you need to have them longer, you can bring them here to renew them.
content.trans: 如果需要更换它们，你可以把它们带到这里来换。

content.text: If you don't, you get charged ten cents a day for each book. Okay. Thanks.
content.trans: 如果不去，你每本书每天要付10元。好的，谢谢。

content.text: All right. So, borrowing books in a library seems pretty simple.
content.trans: 英语：一切好。所以，借阅图书馆的书籍似乎挺简单的。

content.text: And you don't really have to leave a deposit or something just in case you steal the book or you're damaged it.
content.trans: 你不需要在万一你偷了书或损坏了它的情况下留下存款或者什么。

content.text: How do you deal with this? No. Well, libraries are a wonderful part of...
content.trans: 英语：如何应对这个？不。图书馆是个多姿多彩的一部分...

content.text: Well, at least American culture. I'm not really sure how they work in other places.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，至少美国文化。我并不太清楚他们在其他地方是如何工作的。

content.text: In America, there's a lot of federal money in libraries. In fact, I think it was Franklin Roosevelt,
content.trans: 美国，图书馆里有很多联邦钱。事实上，我认为这是弗兰克·德拉诺总统的钱。

content.text: who really helps get a library system in place in America.
content.trans: 美国的图书馆系统怎么才能顺利建立起来？

content.text: So, they're a part of this system of kind of community sharing and information.
content.trans: 所以，他们属于这个系统中的一些部分，共享知识和信息。

content.text: You can go to the library and look for jobs. They have computers.
content.trans: 英语：你可以去图书馆寻找工作。他们有电脑。

content.text: Many have DVD and video sections. Many have very wonderful CD sections.
content.trans: 许多都有DVD和视频区。许多都有非常精彩的CD区。

content.text: So, basically, it's a community center for information, knowledge.
content.trans: 所以，基本上，它就是一个信息、知识的社区中心。

content.text: And it's almost a relationship of trust. I trust that the library will provide for me and the library will trust that I don't destroy a book.
content.trans: 而且，这是一个信任关系。我信任图书馆会为我提供服务，并且图书馆也会信任我不破坏一本书。

content.text: Of course, if you do, you have to pay.
content.trans: 当然，如果你这样做，你必须支付。

content.text: We have to pay. So, is it a federal offense to steal a book from a library?
content.trans: 我们必须交税。所以，偷书从图书馆窃取是否构成盗窃罪？

content.text: I don't know, but it's pretty big deal to steal a book from the library.
content.trans: 我不知道，但这是一件挺大的事儿来偷一本图书馆的书。

content.text: They certainly will know who you are because they have your information, your driver's license.
content.trans: 他们当然会知道你是谁，因为你有你的信息和驾照。

content.text: It's actually pretty interesting, especially because, as you said, libraries.
content.trans: 英语：实际上挺有趣的，尤其是因为你说的图书馆。

content.text: There's a lot of money put into libraries. So, it's all communities have them.
content.trans: 英语：有很多钱投入图书馆。所以，它们都有社区来提供。

content.text: As you say, DVDs or movies or a lot of different types of books.
content.trans: 您说，DVDs、电影或各种各样的书籍。

content.text: And in other countries, like maybe in Latin America, it's not as popular to have a community library where you can go and check things out.
content.trans: 英语：它在其他国家，比如拉丁美洲，不太像有社区图书馆，你可以在那里借书。

content.text: Because there's not that much money involved as well.
content.trans: 因为参与资金不多，所以。

content.text: But we would be curious to know how it works in your country. Maybe your country has some beautiful or extensive libraries.
content.trans: 但是我们可能想知道它在中国的运作方式。也许你的国家有一些美丽的或广泛的图书馆。

content.text: Yeah, I'm very curious as well. So, public libraries do have them.
content.trans: 是的，我也很好奇。所以公共图书馆也有它们。

content.text: And if you don't, do you also have university libraries you can go to?
content.trans: 如果不去，你还有大学图书馆可以去吗？

content.text: Let us know our website is engloshpad.com.
content.trans: 让我们告知我们的网站是英文版。

content.text: Alright, guys. We'll see you there. Bye.
content.trans: 好的，朋友们。我们见了。再见。
